headline: EU AI Act Compliance Gap Creates $2.3B Defense Software Opportunity
snippet: A new compliance gap between EU AI Act requirements and current defense software capabilities opens a significant market for dual-use compliance tooling.

headline: $1.5T Defense Budget Push Meets Innovation Org Shake-Up
snippet: House Armed Services is charting a path to a $1.5 trillion defense budget while DOGE-driven restructuring reshapes how the Pentagon buys technology.
